_comment: Rustic S10.3 world-gen: add olive + ironwood to temperate forests while KEEPING Dynamic Trees' own oak/birch. DT 1.21 has no merge operation: splice_before/splice_after layer a WHOLE selector and a non-empty random pool always 'handles', so it SHADOWS the biome's natives instead of adding to them. The only way to add species and keep the originals is a single REPLACE that re-specifies the full pool. The native weights (dynamictrees:oak:4, dynamictrees:birch:1) are copied verbatim from DT's own forest template; only 'species' is set here so density/chance/forestness are inherited from DT's forest entry. The file MUST be named 'default' so its resource path equals 'default': BiomePopulatorsResourceLoader.isDefaultPopulator(path)=='default' is the gate that routes a world_gen populator into BiomeDatabases.getDefault(); any other name is treated as a per-dimension populator the overworld never consults. NOTE: olive/ironwood only spawn once trees/rustic/jo_codes/{olive,ironwood}.txt supply their world-gen JoCodes (DT 1.21 world-gen replays baked JoCodes; with none, Species.generate returns false).

Rustic: olive + ironwood in plains, added to DT's plains pool (dynamictrees:oak:24, dynamictrees:apple_oak:1 copied verbatim). Plains density is 0 / chance 0.03 in DT by design, so trees (oak and rustic alike) are rare here; we inherit that rarity rather than override it.

Rustic: ironwood only in swamps (legacy: ironwood in SWAMP, olive not). DT's swamp entry uses a STATIC swamp_oak; we convert it to a weighted pool keeping swamp_oak dominant so we ADD ironwood instead of shadowing the native. density/chance inherited from DT's swamp entry (noise()*0.2, 0.75).

Rustic: ironwood only in jungle (legacy: ironwood in JUNGLE, olive not). Added to DT's jungle pool (jungle:15, mega_jungle:3, cocoa:1 copied verbatim) so jungle trees + cocoa remain dominant and ironwood is a small addition. density/forestness/chance inherited from DT's jungle entry.
